tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in light, near-black in dark; the studio's default ground for books, sites and apps.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and anything that sits on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines, the logo's square and letters. On `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes (14:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, taglines. On `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes (6.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet card edges only. Decorative: never the sole border of a control (use `ink` or `signal` there).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The studio colour, a soft sage. The + in the logo, primary buttons and the one highlight on a page. Text on it is `on-signal`. Holds 3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised`, so it can also be an outline, border or icon; never body text (use `signal-text`).

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Links and accented words in sage. On `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` or `ochre` fill, in both themes (5.4:1 or better). Never white on `signal`.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Second accent, a warm ochre. Book covers, gift packaging, the `ochre` Tag and seasonal highlights. Fills only, with `on-signal` text (8:1 or better); never text or thin lines on `paper` (2:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring in `ink`, offset 2px from the control. Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors only: the error message text and the 2px border of a field in error. On `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes (5.9:1 or better). Always paired with a written message and a "!" marker, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed backdrop behind a `Dialog`. Never used for anything else.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero statement per page or a book back: uppercase, four words or fewer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers and landing headlines. Lowercase sentences up to about eight words, or uppercase up to four.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card, dialog and in-page headings. Sentence case.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Numbers, prices, issue and volume labels, short stamps. Uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A small studio making software, books and gifts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We design, write and build things we'd want to own.
styles.usage: Default running text in apps and on the web.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, button captions, tags, navigation. Uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and version numbers on the software side, in the device's own monospace font.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Use the named steps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to label, label to field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control; between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines in a card; between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding; gaps between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding on small screens; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; gaps between cards; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Be generous: space is part of the refinement.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Blocks, cards, images and book covers are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small controls only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and badges. Buttons stay square.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Elevation is only for things that sit above the page: a card lifting on hover, a header stuck on scroll, menus, dialogs. Warm ink-tinted shadows in light; deeper, tighter black in dark, where a 1px `line` border does most of the work.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Level 0, the default for everything on the page: cards, inputs, sections. Separation comes from `line` borders and space.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: a card resting slightly above a busy background, a pressed or selected tile.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: an interactive card on hover, the site header once the page scrolls under it.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Level 3: menus, dropdowns, popovers and toasts, anything anchored to a control and floating over content.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Level 4, the highest: dialogs and sheets over a `scrim`. One per screen.
